_comment: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) or let the app create it on first 'Save defaults'. Missing keys fall back to src/app_config.py defaults.
_comment_tailnet_host: tailnet_host is any hostname or IP the phone can reach this PC on: a Tailscale MagicDNS name (e.g. 'pc.example-tailnet.ts.net'), a VPN/corporate DNS name, or a static VPN/LAN IP — the tailnet_ spelling is historical, no Tailscale required. The Apps tab builds each running app's remote URL as <scheme>://<tailnet_host>:<port>/ (http vs https auto-detected per app) so you can tap it open from the phone, and the tray's Copy remote URL falls back to it when the tailscale CLI is absent. Leave it empty to disable the Open button.
